name: Hikma Pharmaceuticals PLC
summary: Hikma Pharmaceuticals PLC develops, manufactures, markets, and sells a range of generic, specialty, and branded pharmaceutical products. The company operates through three segments: Injectables, Hikma Rx, and Branded. The Injectables segment provides generic and specialty injectable products primarily for use in hospitals. The Branded segment offers branded generics and in-licensed products to retail and hospital markets. The Hikma Rx segment offers oral, respiratory, and other generic and specialty products for the retail market.
